## Features
- Genuine birch bark gives this tree natural rustic appeal
- Freestanding design suits tabletops, shelves and mantels
- Pine needles cones and berries add festive detail below
- Lightweight yet sturdy construction makes the decoration easy to move when updating your festive display.
- A charming Christmas gift choice, combining natural materials with rustic woodland character.
- Suitable for indoor festive displays.
- Freestanding tabletop decoration designed for indoor placement on tables, shelves or mantels.
- Natural rustic finish with pine needles, cones and berries arranged at the base.
- Made from genuine birch bark for an authentic natural appearance.
- Fire-retardant design for added peace of mind during seasonal indoor decorating.

## Information
Bring a natural, woodland feel to your seasonal styling with this 30cm Christmas Tree Shape Birch Bark Wooden Table Top Decoration. Designed in a tree shape and finished with genuine birch bark, it offers a rustic look that suits festive decorating in living rooms, hallways, dining spaces and other indoor areas. The decorative base features pine needles, cones and berries, adding extra seasonal detail and helping the piece feel warm, traditional and easy to style. This freestanding decoration is made to sit neatly on tabletops, shelves and mantels, so you can place it wherever you want a simple Christmas accent. Its sturdy yet lightweight construction makes it easy to move as you refresh your display through the season. The natural materials give the ornament an authentic finish, while the intricate bark pattern creates visual interest without needing additional decoration. A practical choice for homes that favour rustic Christmas decor, this table top piece works well alongside both classic and contemporary festive themes. The off-white tones of the birch bark blend easily with greenery, candles, lights and other seasonal accessories, helping you create a coordinated display with minimal effort. Because it is freestanding, it can be used on its own as a focal point or combined with other decorations for a fuller arrangement. The size is clearly suited to smaller display areas where a statement decoration is wanted without taking up too much space. At 30cm high, it offers noticeable height while remaining compact enough for everyday home styling during the holidays. The combination of natural texture and simple form makes it an appealing decorative feature for Christmas entertaining or quiet seasonal displays. This birch bark table top decoration also makes a thoughtful gift idea for family or friends who enjoy nature-inspired festive styling. Its charming tree-shaped design symbolises the season in an understated way, making it suitable for gifting as well as personal use. Whether placed on a shelf beside existing decor or used as part of a centrepiece, it adds a calm, cosy feel to your Christmas setting. Easy to position and simple to enjoy year after year, this wooden decoration offers a tasteful way to bring seasonal character into the home. It combines rustic style with festive detail in one freestanding design that feels both traditional and distinctive.

## Information
Bring a cosy seasonal feel to your home with this red wooden Christmas tree tabletop decoration. Designed as a festive standing decoration, it works well as a centrepiece for living rooms, hallways, mantelpieces or shelf displays during the Christmas season. The decorative tree features pine and berry-style details that help create a traditional festive look while adding colour and character to your interior décor. Made from wooden material, this Christmas decoration is intended to offer a durable and eco-friendly finish for seasonal display. Its tabletop format makes it easy to position in different indoor spaces without taking up too much room, while the red colour provides a bold festive accent that suits classic holiday styling. The design is aimed at helping you create a rich Christmas atmosphere with an eye-catching decorative piece that complements other seasonal ornaments. This light-up decoration is battery operated for flexible placement and requires 3 x AA batteries, which are not included. It includes 15 small warm white LED bulbs that give off a steady light with no flashing effect, helping to produce a calm and welcoming glow throughout the home. The warm white lighting adds depth to the design without overpowering the rest of your display, making it suitable for creating a soft festive ambience. With dimensions of 42 x 35 x 5 cm, this tabletop Christmas tree is sized for decorative indoor use where you want a compact but noticeable seasonal feature. The combination of wooden construction, red finish, pine accents and warm white LEDs gives it a traditional look that can be enjoyed year after year as part of your Christmas decorating scheme. It is supplied as 1 piece and offers an easy way to add festive style to your home décor. Whether placed on a table, sideboard or shelf, this LED wooden tree helps set a welcoming mood for family gatherings and seasonal celebrations. Its simple battery-powered design means you can position it where it looks best without needing a mains connection, while the steady warm white lights help bring an elegant finishing touch to your Christmas display.

## Features
- Integrated fibre optic LEDs create a bright festive glow
- Eight light modes let you vary the display easily
- Star topper adds a classic finish to seasonal décor
- Sturdy stand helps keep the tree steady indoors
- Ready-to-display design saves time on decoration

## Information
From the manufacturer, this fibre optic Christmas tree brings a bright, colourful finish to seasonal decorating. The built-in multi-coloured lighting helps create a warm festive glow across the branches, while the illuminated star topper adds a classic finishing touch. Designed for simple indoor display, it offers a convenient way to bring holiday charm to living rooms, offices and other spaces where a cheerful centrepiece is wanted. The tree is pre-lit with integrated fibre optic LED lights, so there is no need to add separate string lights before setting it up. The lighting is built into the design to provide an eye-catching display with minimal effort. An eight-mode lighting effect gives you different ways to enjoy the tree’s appearance through the season, helping you vary the look without changing decorations or adding extra accessories. A sturdy stand supports the tree and helps keep it steady once positioned in place. This practical base is designed to provide reliable support for indoor use, making the tree suitable for creating a focal point in your home or workplace during Christmas. Its ready-to-display format makes it straightforward to place, enjoy and pack away again after the season has finished. The product’s fibre optic construction gives it a distinctive illuminated style that stands out in festive settings. Multi-coloured light effects brighten the tree from within and work with the star topper to create a lively seasonal feature. Create a striking seasonal display with this 4ft black artificial Christmas tree, designed for indoor decorative use in the home, office or retail-style settings. ## Information
Create a warm and inviting festive display with the Pelle & Sol Pre-Lit Artificial Christmas Tree. Designed with dense PVC pine-style branches, this reusable tree provides a realistic green backdrop for baubles, garlands and other Christmas decorations. Built-in warm white LED lights remove the need to install separate light strings, while 8 lighting modes let you choose from steady, twinkling and fading effects. The convenient timer automatically runs the lights for 6 hours before switching them off for 18 hours. A slim profile makes the tree ideal for living rooms, hallways, apartments, offices and other spaces where floor space is limited. Adjustable branches can be shaped during assembly for a fuller appearance, while the sturdy metal stand provides reliable support. Available in 4ft, 5ft, 6ft and 7ft sizes with increasing tip and LED counts to suit different festive spaces.

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- 90 cm tabletop size for flexible seasonal placement
- 86 branch tips form abundant greenery profile
- Santa inspired design captures a playful character
- 20 warm white LED lights provide gentle brightness

## Information
Bring playful Christmas cheer to your holiday decorating!This mini tabletop Christmas tree combines seasonal greenery, cheerful Santa details, and inviting illumination in a compact format that brings personality to your festive arrangement. Standing 3 ft/90 cm tall, the artificial Xmas tree features 86 verdant branch tips for plentiful greenery, complemented by a plaid hat, soft white beard, and matching Santa-style boots. 20 warm white LED lights brighten the foliage, while 8 lighting modes (combination, in waves, sequential, slo glo, chasing/flash, fade, twinkle/flash, steady on) provide multiple effects for changing the ambiance throughout the season. With battery operation, the lighting is not restricted by a nearby outlet, and the integrated timer automatically follows a 6-hour on/18-hour off cycle. Premium PVC foliage offers flame-retardant, fade-resistant, smell-free, and non-allergic properties for added reassurance around children and pets. At the bottom, cement-filled black boots provide weighted support to maintain a steady position while carrying the Santa theme through to the base. Compact and easy to reposition, this small realistic Christmas tree fits neatly on entry tables, mantels, office desks, and other limited surfaces. Note: Battery box requires 3 AA batteries, not included.Note: The decorations are not included.

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Remote control makes changing light modes quick
- Eight lighting modes help vary your festive display
- Adjustable brightness allows softer or brighter

- Pop-up artificial tree design includes a sturdy foldable stand for practical setup and handling.

## Information
Create a festive focal point in smaller spaces with this 4ft LED fibre optic Christmas tree. Designed for indoor seasonal decorating, it offers a compact height that suits tabletops, offices, porches or rooms where space is limited. The fibre optic effect gives the tree a decorative illuminated finish, while the LED lights help produce an eye-catching display for Christmas and winter celebrations. With remote control operation, you can switch between eight light modes to suit different moods and occasions without needing to reach the tree each time. Adjustable brightness lets you tailor the look of the display, whether you want a subtle glow or a brighter feature for evening use. A timer function adds everyday convenience and helps manage your lighting routine during the festive period. The tree is made from PVC for a practical artificial finish that is easy to handle and assemble. Its lightweight construction makes it straightforward to position in the home and simple to store away after the season. This makes it a useful choice for those who want a decorative tree with flexible lighting controls but without taking up too much room. The compact design works well as part of a larger Christmas display or as a standalone feature in smaller settings. Whether placed in a living room corner, hallway, office or sheltered outdoor space, it provides an attractive seasonal accent with useful control features built in. For customers looking for an artificial Christmas tree that combines convenience with decorative appeal, this 4ft fibre optic option offers a practical balance of style and ease of use. It is suitable for creating a welcoming festive atmosphere while keeping setup simple and storage manageable once celebrations are over.

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- 997 LED CHRISTMAS DISPLAY  Create an impressive festive centrepiece with this large light up pyramid tree, illuminated by 997 rainbow LEDs arranged around its distinctive cone-shaped frame.
- ANIMATED SPINNING LIGHT EFFECTS  The LEDs produce eye-catching spinning effects across the tree, bringing movement and added visual impact to your Christmas garden, entrance or indoor festive display.
- ADJUSTABLE SPEED CONTROLLER  A dedicated controller is supplied so you can alter the speed of the animated lighting effects and customise the appearance of the display.
- 8-HOUR AUTOMATIC TIMER  Use the convenient timer function to keep the lights illuminated for 8 hours before automatically switching them off for 16 hours, repeating the cycle daily.
- MAINS POWERED WITH 10M CABLE  Powered from the mains for consistent illumination and supplied with a generous 10m power cable.

## Information
Create a spectacular festive focal point with this striking 3m light up pyramid tree. Packed with an impressive 997 LEDs, the tall cone-shaped display light up with rainbow illumination with eye-catching spinning light effects including steady on effect for a Christmas decoration that really comes alive after dark. Designed to create maximum impact without the bulk of a traditional Christmas tree, the LEDs form a dramatic pyramid silhouette around a strong central metal pole. A sturdy black base helps support the structure, making it ideal for creating a statement feature in gardens, on patios, beside an entrance or as part of a larger festive display. Mains powered with a generous 10m power cable, the tree gives you added flexibility when positioning it around the home or garden. A supplied speed controller lets you adjust the pace of the lighting effects including static to suit the atmosphere you're creating. Slow things down for a softer festive shimmer or increase the speed for a more energetic animated display. The built-in 8-hour timer makes daily use wonderfully convenient. Once activated, the tree remains illuminated for 8 hours before automatically switching off for 16 hours, then repeats at the same time each day. Suitable for indoor and outdoor use (transformer plug must remain indoors) Product Specifications 997 White and Warm White Multi-Action LEDs Height: 3m Length: 70cm Width: 70cm Mains Powered with 10m Power Cable Timer Function 8 hours on 16 hours off

## Features
- Grand Festive Statement Piece: Stunning 8ft double door tree archway creates a show-stopping entrance for your home, event, or festive display.
- Beautiful Snow Flocked Finish: Each branch is delicately dusted with realistic snow flock, giving the arch a soft, wintry appearance.

- Perfect for Entrances & Displays: Ideal for framing doorways, hallways, event spaces, or photo backdrops, adding instant festive elegance.

## Information
Create a grand and enchanting entrance to your festive celebrations with the Samuel Alexander 8ft Double Door Flocked Christmas Tree Arch. A stunning centrepiece designed to transform any doorway, hallway, or event space into a magical winter wonderland. This beautifully designed double door tree archway features an impressive 2000 lush branch tips, crafted from high quality materials for a lifelike, realistic appearance. Each branch is lightly coated with a delicate layer of snow flock, adding a soft, wintry touch reminiscent of freshly fallen snow. The result is a full and elegant display that perfectly captures the charm and serenity of the festive season. Supported by green metal stands at the base of each pillar, the structure is both sturdy and stylish, ensuring stability while maintaining a natural, tree like look. With an external height of 265 cm and an external length of 210 cm, this grand archway makes a dramatic and memorable statement piece. Ideal for framing doorways, entrances, or creating a photo-worthy feature at Christmas gatherings and events. Please note; the branches of the archway will require to be fluffed and rearranged to achieve the appearance in our product images. Suitable for indoor and sheltered outdoor use. ## Information
Infuse vitality and festive spirit to everywhere with the pre-lit Christmas trees set of 2!The vivid artificial cypress tree is crafted with 173 lifelike branch tips for a natural look. Delicate clusters of withered branches and 15 sprigs of vibrant red berries add layers of color and authentic detail, perfectly capturing the essence of winter. ## Features
- Artificial Christmas tree, lasting festive magic
- Realistic with injection moulded and PVC needles
- Flexible, detailed branches

- Effortless plug-in mechanism
- Artificial Christmas tree for long-lasting festive magic
- Realistic appearance with injection moulded and PVC needles
- Flexible, detailed branches
- Foldable tree stand made from durable wood
- Effortless plug-in mechanism

## Information
The artificial Christmas tree Cupid from tectake is the perfect choice for any home looking to enhance their festive spirit. With the trees rich green colour, it brings a cosy atmosphere to your living room. Thanks to the use of injection moulding and PVC needles, the artificial Christmas tree looks particularly realistic. In the injection moulding process, the needles are made three-dimensionally and precisely mimic real fir needles. The tree trunk with its wooden appearance enhances the realistic look and gives your Christmas tree an authentic look, making every room shine in festive splendour. A real advantage of an artificial Christmas tree is its ease of care. You don't have to worry about drying out or annoying needle loss, as is the case with real trees. It remains in perfect shape throughout the Christmas season and can be reused every year. This makes it a particularly sustainable solution for the holidays. With the innovative plug-in mechanism, the artificial pine tree can be effortlessly set up in just a few minutes. This leaves more time to add your favourite lights and best decorations so you can truly get into the Christmas spirit. The stable tree stand provides secure support and after the festive season, the Christmas tree can be dismantled into its individual parts and stored compactly. Opt for the artificial Christmas tree Cupid from tectake and enjoy a worry-free festive season in your home, without having to forgo the charm of a natural tree!

## Information
Transform your home into a winter wonderland with this Valmorel Flocked Artificial Christmas Tree from Christow. Available in 5ft, 6ft, 7ft, and 8ft sizes, it features a blend of PVC and pine needles with a heavily flocked finish for an enchanting winter forest look. With its naturally bushy shape and snow-covered branches, it creates a stunning festive centrepiece with minimal decorating required. Snow-Covered Winter Look Featuring a blend of realistic pine needles and classic PVC tips, the Valmorel has a beautifully full and textured look. A heavily flocked finish gives it an enchanting winter forest feel, creating a stunning backdrop for festive lights and decorations. Hinged Branch Construction Designed with hinged branches for easy assembly, the tree slots together while the branches drop naturally into place. Gentle fluffing helps create a bushier shape, allowing you to spend less time assembling and more time admiring your display. Sturdy Green Metal Stand Every tree includes a sturdy green metal stand with silver eyebolts for secure attachment and stable display all season long. Designed to blend naturally with the foliage, it also features rubber feet to help protect hard floors from marks and scratches. Bring timeless festive charm into your home with the Christow Nordmann Fir Artificial Tree. Delivered in a sturdy box with protective caps on each pole, the Verbier Fir is simple to put together. Once the season ends, it can be easily disassembled for compact storage until the following Christmas.

- 12ft height creates an impressive festive focal point
- Black Alaskan Pine styling adds a modern seasonal look

- Fire retardant tips provide added peace of mind indoors

- Safety guidance: not suitable for children under 36 months.

## Information
Bring a bold festive look to your home with this 12ft black Artificial Alaskan Pine Christmas tree. Designed with classic pine tips, it creates an elegant seasonal display while offering a modern alternative to a traditional green tree. The striking black finish makes it ideal for contemporary interiors, themed decorations or anyone looking for a standout centrepiece during the festive season. Made from 100% virgin PVC, the tree is designed for practical seasonal use and features fire retardant tips for added peace of mind when decorating indoors. The wrapped construction means the branches are attached directly to the tree, helping make assembly simpler and reducing the time needed to get everything in place. This design also helps keep the overall shape consistent once assembled, so you can focus on styling rather than complicated setup. A sturdy metal base is included to help support the tree securely, while the plastic stand protector is designed to help protect your floor during installation and display. The combination of strong support and straightforward assembly makes this artificial tree a useful choice for busy households, retail spaces or larger rooms where a tall festive focal point is needed. As an artificial tree, it can be reused year after year, making it a practical addition to your Christmas decorations. The classic pine tip profile gives a familiar evergreen style even with its black finish, helping you create a festive look that feels both traditional in shape and modern in appearance. Whether placed in a living room, hallway or display area, this 12ft tree offers height, presence and convenience in one easy-to-use design. The generous 12ft size makes it suitable for rooms with higher ceilings and areas where you want a more dramatic seasonal impact. Its tall profile creates an eye-catching backdrop for lights, baubles and garlands, while the simple construction supports faster seasonal setup. With its combination of classic shaping, fire retardant tips and a secure metal base, this Artificial Alaskan Pine tree offers a dependable way to build an impressive Christmas display without using a real tree. Ideal for customers seeking an artificial Christmas tree with a distinctive look, this black Alaskan Pine design balances style and practicality. The fire retardant PVC tips, wrapped branch construction and included stand accessories all contribute to an easier decorating experience. If you want a reusable festive centrepiece with strong visual impact and familiar pine styling, this 12ft artificial tree is designed to deliver exactly that.

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Artificial Christmas tree for lasting festive magic
- Realistic appearance thanks to the combination of injection moulded and PVC needles
- Flexible, detailed branches
- Foldable tree stand made of powder-coated steel
- Effortless plug-in mechanism

## Information
The artificial Christmas tree Prancer by tectake is the perfect choice to immerse your home in a cosy, festive atmosphere. The trees rich green and lifelike injection-moulded needles give it a realistic appearance that rivals a real fir tree. The accurately crafted branches offer ample space for all your favourite decorations, from classic baubles to sparkling lights. Thanks to the robust stand made of powder-coated steel, the artificial Christmas tree offers absolute stability even with fully laden branches. The plastic feet on the stand prevent scratches on delicate floors and ensure stability on any surface. Particularly practical: The plug-in mechanism allows for effortless assembly of the Christmas tree with just a few simple steps, without the need for additional tools. Afterwards, you can bend and shape the branches as you wish, and add your best decorations. You don't have to worry about falling needles or watering, as the artificial Christmas tree always remains in splendid form. Made from particularly durable and high-quality materials, this eye-catcher lasts for many years. It is therefore the ideal choice for all those who do not want the hassle of a real tree. After the holidays, the artificial tree can be easily dismantled into its individual parts and stored compactly. This way, it takes up little space and waits to shine in full glory again next year. With the artificial Christmas tree Prancer by tectake, you bring the magic of Christmas into your home!

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Elegant woodland charm
- Natural-looking pe and pvc tips
- Hinged branch construction
- Green metal stand included
- Easy to assemble

## Information
Bring timeless festive charm into your home with the Christow Nordmann Fir Artificial Tree. Designed with a classic tapered silhouette, the Nordmann Fir features a blend of lifelike PE and PVC tips for a dense, natural look. The branches are crafted to capture the character of a real fir, providing plenty of space to hang lights, baubles, and your favourite festive decorations. Pre-attached hinged branches make the Nordmann Fir quick and easy to assemble. Simply slot the poles together, allow the branches to fall into place, then gently fluff them up for a natural shape. Strong and sturdy, the branches provide ample support for lights and ornaments. Each tree comes with a heavy-duty dark green metal stand that blends seamlessly with the lower branches for a stylish, cohesive look. Silver metal eyebolts help keep the tree sturdy and secure, while rubber feet add grip on smooth floors and protect them from marks and scratches. Delivered in a sturdy box with protective caps on each pole, the Verbier Fir is simple to put together. Secure the base section into the stand, slot in the other sections, and allow the branches to drop. Once the season ends, it can be easily disassembled for compact storage until the following Christmas.

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Artificial Christmas tree in rich green with plenty of volume
- Realistic appearance thanks to detailed injection moulded needles
- Quick assembly and disassembly in the plug-in system
- Stable, foldable tree stand made of powder-coated steel with floor-friendly plastic feet
- Particularly low-maintenance

## Information
The artificial Christmas tree Prancer by tectake is the perfect choice to immerse your home in a cosy, festive atmosphere. The trees rich green and lifelike injection-moulded needles give it a realistic appearance that rivals a real fir tree. The accurately crafted branches offer ample space for all your favourite decorations, from classic baubles to sparkling lights. Thanks to the robust stand made of powder-coated steel, the artificial Christmas tree offers absolute stability even with fully laden branches. The plastic feet on the stand prevent scratches on delicate floors and ensure stability on any surface. Particularly practical: The plug-in mechanism allows for effortless assembly of the Christmas tree with just a few simple steps, without the need for additional tools. Afterwards, you can bend and shape the branches as you wish, and add your best decorations. You don't have to worry about falling needles or watering, as the artificial Christmas tree always remains in splendid form. Made from particularly durable and high-quality materials, this eye-catcher lasts for many years. It is therefore the ideal choice for all those who do not want the hassle of a real tree. After the holidays, the artificial tree can be easily dismantled into its individual parts and stored compactly. This way, it takes up little space and waits to shine in full glory again next year. With the artificial Christmas tree Prancer by tectake, you bring the magic of Christmas into your home!

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Elegant woodland charm
- Natural-looking pe and pvc tips
- Hinged branch construction
- Green metal stand included
- Easy to assemble

## Information
Bring timeless festive charm into your home with the Christow Nordmann Fir Artificial Tree. Designed with a classic tapered silhouette, the Nordmann Fir features a blend of lifelike PE and PVC tips for a dense, natural look. The branches are crafted to capture the character of a real fir, providing plenty of space to hang lights, baubles, and your favourite festive decorations. Pre-attached hinged branches make the Nordmann Fir quick and easy to assemble. Simply slot the poles together, allow the branches to fall into place, then gently fluff them up for a natural shape. Strong and sturdy, the branches provide ample support for lights and ornaments. Each tree comes with a heavy-duty dark green metal stand that blends seamlessly with the lower branches for a stylish, cohesive look. Silver metal eyebolts help keep the tree sturdy and secure, while rubber feet add grip on smooth floors and protect them from marks and scratches. Delivered in a sturdy box with protective caps on each pole, the Verbier Fir is simple to put together. Secure the base section into the stand, slot in the other sections, and allow the branches to drop. Once the season ends, it can be easily disassembled for compact storage until the following Christmas.

## Information
Create a festive indoor display with the B&Q 8ft Californian Pine artificial Christmas tree, designed to bring a classic seasonal look to homes, shops, malls and other indoor settings. The tree combines a bushy profile with snow covered green tips, giving the appearance of a winter-inspired decorative centrepiece that suits traditional Christmas decorating schemes. Its hinged branch construction is intended to make assembly straightforward, while also helping when the tree is taken down and stored after use. A sturdy metal base is supplied to help keep the tree standing securely and provide added stability during display. Made with PVC tips and a metal frame and stand, this reusable tree offers a practical option for creating an inviting festive atmosphere year after year. It can be used for Christmas decorating as well as other seasonal or celebratory displays where an indoor decorative tree is needed. The design is suitable for indoor use and provides a simple way to build a welcoming focal point without requiring complicated setup. For households or commercial spaces looking for a dependable decorative tree, this Californian Pine model offers a balance of convenience, structure and seasonal appeal. The included stand with screws helps complete the setup, supporting the tree once assembled so it can be positioned ready for ornaments and lights if desired. Whether placed in a living room, reception area or retail environment, it offers a versatile festive feature that can be reused across multiple seasons.

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Available in sizes 2ft, 3ft, 4ft, 6ft and 7ft
- Indoor use only
- Colour-changing fibre optics
- Includes a star topper with LEDs
- Sparkle baubles provided
- 1.8m black cable
- PLEASE NOTE - THIS TREE DOES NOT COME WITH A REMOTE CONTROL
- Timer included: 8hrs on/16hrs off

## Information
The images on show are of our actual tree. Even with meticulous wrapping, each tree needs to be assembled correctly to get the desired look. First, assemble the tree foundation and then (if needed) install the lower section. Extend the branches of the upper portion down until you discover the electrical connection point. After the connection is completed, make sure the upper and lower electrical connections are in place before putting the top section of the tree into the lower pole (because 2ft, 3ft, and 4ft trees are all one-piece, this step is not required). Fold the first layer of branches just above horizontal form, working your way up from the base of the tree; this should give the branches a narrow \"V\" shape. Once you reach the top layer of your tree, repeat these steps for the remaining tiers. Before you plug in your tree, attach any ornaments or other decorations it may have! If gaps are evident from different angles, raising the back branches relative to the front branches may help. This fills in the \"visual gaps\" without sacrificing the appearance of layers. Work your way down the tree, starting at the top, to disassemble it. Available here as a 2ft (60cm) tree.

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Available in sizes 2ft, 3ft, 4ft, 6ft and 7ft
- Indoor use only
- Colour-changing fibre optics
- Includes a star topper with LEDs
- Sparkle baubles provided
- 1.8m black cable
- PLEASE NOTE - THIS TREE DOES NOT COME WITH A REMOTE CONTROL
- Timer included: 8hrs on/16hrs off

## Information
The images on show are of our real trees. Even with meticulous wrapping, each tree needs to be assembled correctly to get the desired look. First, assemble the tree foundation and then (if needed) install the lower section. Extend the branches of the upper portion down until you discover the electrical connection point. After the connection is completed, make sure the upper and lower electrical connections are in place before putting the top section of the tree into the lower pole (because 2ft, 3ft, and 4ft trees are all one-piece, this step is not required). Fold the first layer of branches just above horizontal form, working your way up from the base of the tree; this should give the branches a narrow \"V\" shape. Once you reach the top layer of your tree, repeat these steps for the remaining tiers. Before you plug in your tree, attach any ornaments or other decorations it may have! If gaps are evident from different angles, raising the back branches relative to the front branches may help. This fills in the \"visual gaps\" without sacrificing the appearance of layers. Work your way down the tree, starting at the top, to disassemble it. Available here as a 3ft (90cm) tree.

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- LED fibre optic Christmas tree
- Colorful butterfly decorations
- Color-Changing Lights
- 2ft size suits smaller rooms, while still offering a noticeable festive display for indoor decorating. Reduced footprint makes it easier to position in corners or beside furniture without overwhelming the room.
- Pre-lit fibre optic branches create an illuminated seasonal effect that adds brightness across the tree without separate string lights. This helps simplify decorating and gives you an eye-catching centrepiece with less setup effort during Christmas.
- Natural green tree a traditional Christmas look that blends well with other decorations. The familiar colour and classic shape make it easy to style with baubles, ribbons or additional ornaments for a personalised festive display.
- Distinctive butterfly-style decoration adds visual interest and helps the tree stand out in living rooms, hallways or reception areas while keeping the overall footprint small and easy to place.
- Suitable for indoor festive displays, this compact pre-lit tree can be stored carefully after use and brought back each year as part of your Christmas decorating routine in homes with limited space.

## Information
Easy installation & dismantle, automatically changing light colours. Light up your home with pure magic this season thanks to this lovely Christmas tree. Its artificial design will last you for several years, and it is safely placed in homes with children and pets. Specifications: Material: PVC Size: 5Ft with 190Tips Width: 70cm approx. products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Snow Dusted Branches
- Frosted White-Tipped Branches
- Battery Powered

## Information
This 2ft snowy tree is designed for the spaces that don't suit a full-sized tree – windowsills, bedside tables, desks, and dining tables. Snow-dusted white-tipped branches sit in a hessian base that gives it a neat, self-contained look without the need for a separate stand or pot. It's ready to place and display. 30 warm white LEDs are pre-woven throughout for a steady, warm glow. Battery powered and fully wire-free, it can be positioned anywhere in the room without a socket nearby. A built-in digital timer runs an 8 hours on / 16 hours off cycle, so the lights switch themselves on and off each day. Light branch shaping required. Unpack, shape the branches by hand for the fullest appearance, switch on the lights, and it's done. Ideal for: Windowsills, bedside tables, desks, dining tables, home offices, and any space where a small but fully formed Christmas tree makes the difference. Please Note: For indoor use only. Batteries not included – Requires 3x AA batteries. CE certified. Handle the frosted finish with care. Branches require light shaping by hand after unboxing.Features: Snow-dusted branches in a hessian base – a self-contained styled display piece that needs no stand no pot and no extra decoration Frosted white-tipped branches for genuine fullness at this scale Battery powered with a built-in 8-hour digital timer – fully wire-free place it anywhere without needing a socket nearby Hessian base provides a stable neat finish without a separate stand Lights: 30 pre-lit warm white LEDs Power: Battery powered | Digital timer: 8 hours on / 16 hours off Includes: 1x 2ft pre-lit faux snowy Christmas tree with hessian base Materials: Plastic (branches with frosted finish) Hessian (base) Dimensions: Height: 2ft (61cm) Weights: Approx. 1kg Colours: White (frosted/snow finish) Brown/natural (hessian base) Additional Info: Lights: Simple on/off operation no settings to adjust. Power: Battery powered – Requires 3x AA batteries. Wire free. CE certified. Timer: Built-in digital timer – 8 hours on / 16 hours off. Assembly: Shape branches by hand after unboxing for the fullest appearance. Storage: Store in a cool dry place between seasons. Care: Handle the frosted finish gently. Wipe lightly with a dry cloth if needed. Keep away from open flames.

## Information
Bring a modern festive look to your home with this 5ft pre-lit black Alaskan pine Christmas tree. The bold black finish gives a contemporary twist to classic seasonal decorating, while the built-in white LED lights help create an eye-catching display with less effort at setup time. Designed for indoor use, this artificial tree offers a practical option for creating a seasonal centrepiece in living rooms, hallways, dining areas or other display spaces where a compact yet stylish tree is needed. Made from PVC, the tree has a lightweight feel that makes it easier to handle when setting up, decorating and storing away after the season. The material also supports a natural-looking pine style that works well with traditional baubles, garlands and other festive decorations. A strong metal stand is included to help support stable placement once assembled, giving you a reliable base for your Christmas display. This tree is designed for straightforward seasonal use, with easy assembly that helps reduce the time spent preparing your room for Christmas. Once the festivities are over, it can be folded down and stored ready for reuse in future years, making it a practical choice for repeated seasonal decorating. Its reusable construction offers convenience for households looking for an artificial tree that can be brought out year after year without needing replacement each season. products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Available in sizes 2ft, 3ft, 4ft, 6ft and 7ft
- Indoor use only
- Colour-changing fibre optics
- Includes a star topper with LEDs
- Sparkle baubles provided
- 1.8m black cable
- PLEASE NOTE - THIS TREE DOES NOT COME WITH A REMOTE CONTROL
- Timer included: 8hrs on/16hrs off

## Information
The images on show are of our real trees. Even with meticulous wrapping, each tree needs to be assembled correctly to get the desired look. First, assemble the tree foundation and then (if needed) install the lower section. Extend the branches of the upper portion down until you discover the electrical connection point. After the connection is completed, make sure the upper and lower electrical connections are in place before putting the top section of the tree into the lower pole (because 2ft, 3ft, and 4ft trees are all one-piece, this step is not required). Fold the first layer of branches just above horizontal form, working your way up from the base of the tree; this should give the branches a narrow \"V\" shape. Once you reach the top layer of your tree, repeat these steps for the remaining tiers. Before you plug in your tree, attach any ornaments or other decorations it may have! If gaps are evident from different angles, raising the back branches relative to the front branches may help. This fills in the \"visual gaps\" without sacrificing the appearance of layers. Work your way down the tree, starting at the top, to disassemble it. Available here as a 4ft (120cm) tree.

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Available in sizes 2ft, 3ft, 4ft, 6ft and 7ft
- Indoor use only
- Colour-changing fibre optics
- Includes a star topper with LEDs
- Sparkle baubles provided
- 1.8m black cable
- PLEASE NOTE - THIS TREE DOES NOT COME WITH A REMOTE CONTROL
- Timer included: 8hrs on/16hrs off

## Information
The images on show are of our real trees. Even with meticulous wrapping, each tree needs to be assembled correctly to get the desired look. First, assemble the tree foundation and then (if needed) install the lower section. Extend the branches of the upper portion down until you discover the electrical connection point. After the connection is completed, make sure the upper and lower electrical connections are in place before putting the top section of the tree into the lower pole (because 2ft, 3ft, and 4ft trees are all one-piece, this step is not required). Fold the first layer of branches just above horizontal form, working your way up from the base of the tree; this should give the branches a narrow \"V\" shape. Once you reach the top layer of your tree, repeat these steps for the remaining tiers. Before you plug in your tree, attach any ornaments or other decorations it may have! If gaps are evident from different angles, raising the back branches relative to the front branches may help. This fills in the \"visual gaps\" without sacrificing the appearance of layers. Work your way down the tree, starting at the top, to disassemble it. Available here as a 5ft (150cm) tree.

Bring a warm festive feel to your home with this 7ft Green Alaskan Pine pre-lit artificial Christmas tree. ## Features
- Flexible branches with micro LED bulbs
- Realistic white bark effect
- Mains-powered with 5-metre cable

## Information
Give your home a winter forest feel this Christmas with our white light up twig tree. Beautifully illuminated by warm white micro LEDs to create a warm, inviting feature. The twig tree comes in a choice of sizes and is suitable for indoor and outdoor display. The tree is illuminated by micro LEDs which are brighter than normal LEDs. If youre displaying it outside, you can secure it to your lawn using the ground pegs included.

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- 118 RGB LEDs create a colourful festive display across 12 cascading light strands, finished with a bright 10-LED star topper for a distinctive Christmas tree effect.
- Control the lighting from your phone or included controller using the SurpLife app, with adjustable colours, effects and modes to suit different Christmas displays and occasions.
- Designed for flexible indoor and outdoor decorating, with a sturdy 70cm base, soft copper wire construction and ground pegs to help keep the display secure outside.
- Simple mains-powered setup with a generous 5m cable, giving you more freedom when positioning the light around gardens, patios, entrances or indoor festive displays.

## Information
Transform your Christmas display with the Pegdev 1.5m RGB LED Star Tree Light, designed to create an eye-catching tree-shaped feature filled with colour and movement. Twelve cascading light strands flow down from the illuminated star topper, with 118 colour-changing LEDs creating a bright festive display for your home or garden. Choose colours, lighting effects and different modes using the included controller or compatible smartphone app, making it easy to change the appearance of your display throughout the Christmas season. From colourful animated effects to a decorative festive glow, the lighting can be adjusted to complement your chosen Christmas theme. Suitable for creating a standout feature in living spaces, entrance areas, gardens and patios, the 1.2m design provides plenty of visual impact without requiring the space of a full-sized Christmas tree. The sturdy base helps support the tree-shaped display, while the supplied BS IP20 transformer provides mains-powered operation. Ideal as a standalone Christmas decoration or as part of a larger festive lighting display, this RGB LED Star Tree brings together colourful illumination, smart control and an impressive cascading design for an easy way to brighten your seasonal décor.

## Information
Bring a warm festive feel to your home with this 3ft prelit Christmas tree, designed for indoor seasonal decorating. The tree features a firework style branch shape that gives it a full decorative look, while the PVC material helps create a classic needle effect. Its compact size makes it suitable for smaller rooms, hallways, porches or anywhere you want an easy Christmas display without taking up too much floor space. This prelit design saves time during setup and helps you create an attractive focal point with less effort than decorating a tree from scratch. The structured branch style is ideal for adding baubles, ribbons and other decorations to suit your chosen theme. Whether you are styling a cosy corner at home, adding seasonal detail to an office reception area or creating a simple festive feature in a shop display, this tree offers a practical and versatile option. Made with PVC, the tree is intended for repeated seasonal use when cared for appropriately and stored carefully between celebrations. The compact 3ft format is especially useful where space is limited, making it easier to add festive atmosphere without needing a larger tree. Its prelit format also supports quick decorating, helping you get ready for Christmas with less fuss. For best results, place the tree on a stable surface and follow any assembly or care guidance supplied with the product. Keep away from heat sources and always use electrical items in line with the manufacturer’s instructions. This tree is suitable for indoor decorative use only and can be combined with your own lights, ornaments and finishing touches if desired. A straightforward choice for customers looking for a small prelit Christmas tree with a decorative branch style and a traditional festive appearance.

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Available in sizes 2ft, 3ft, 4ft, 6ft and 7ft
- Indoor use only
- Colour-changing fibre optics
- Includes a star topper with LEDs
- Sparkle baubles provided
- 1.8m black cable
- PLEASE NOTE - THIS TREE DOES NOT COME WITH A REMOTE CONTROL
- Timer included: 8hrs on/16hrs off

## Information
The images on show are of our real trees. Even with meticulous wrapping, each tree needs to be assembled correctly to get the desired look. First, assemble the tree foundation and then (if needed) install the lower section. Extend the branches of the upper portion down until you discover the electrical connection point. After the connection is completed, make sure the upper and lower electrical connections are in place before putting the top section of the tree into the lower pole (because 2ft, 3ft, and 4ft trees are all one-piece, this step is not required). Fold the first layer of branches just above horizontal form, working your way up from the base of the tree; this should give the branches a narrow \"V\" shape. Once you reach the top layer of your tree, repeat these steps for the remaining tiers. Before you plug in your tree, attach any ornaments or other decorations it may have! If gaps are evident from different angles, raising the back branches relative to the front branches may help. This fills in the \"visual gaps\" without sacrificing the appearance of layers. Work your way down the tree, starting at the top, to disassemble it. Available here as a 6ft (180cm) tree.

## Information
Bring a classic festive feel to your home with this 4ft Pre-lit Green Helsinki Christmas Tree. Designed for seasonal decoration, it features a traditional green finish and built-in warm white LED lights to create a welcoming glow without the need for separate light strings. The tree is made from PVC for a practical artificial finish that can be reused year after year, making it a convenient choice for Christmas decorating indoors. This tree is supplied in a compact 4ft size, making it suitable for smaller rooms, hallways, offices or as an additional decorative feature alongside larger displays. Once in place, the built-in LED lighting can be powered simply by plugging in the transformer, helping you enjoy quick festive illumination with less effort. The long-life energy saving LEDs are described as lasting up to 50,000 hours, offering added convenience for repeated seasonal use. This artificial Christmas tree is intended for indoor decoration and can help transform living spaces into a cheerful winter display. It is suitable for customers looking for a pre-lit option with a natural-looking green finish, practical assembly features and reliable support from the included stand. As with all indoor electrical decorations, the transformer should remain plugged indoors at all times during use. With its combination of pre-lit convenience, PVC construction and compact height, this Helsinki tree offers an easy way to create a festive focal point. It suits homes that need an attractive Christmas tree without the upkeep of real foliage, while still delivering a warm seasonal atmosphere through its integrated lighting and simple design.

- Pre-Lit Halden Fir Christmas Tree with a sparse, natural look
- Available in 5ft and 6ft sizes with 72 / 85 realistic PE tips
- 240 / 300 static warm white micro LEDs with timer function

## Information
Add a touch of festive elegance to your home with this Pre-Lit Halden Fir Sparse Artificial Christmas Tree. Available in 5ft and 6ft sizes, its slender shape and sparse, Scandi-inspired silhouette make it a beautiful choice for modern interiors. Lightly flocked branches create a frosted winter look, while static warm white micro LEDs cast a soft festive glow to create an enchanting Christmas display. Indoor Plug with 5m Cable Powered by an IP20-rated UK transformer plug for indoor sockets only. products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Available in sizes 2ft, 3ft, 4ft, 6ft and 7ft
- Indoor use only
- Colour-changing fibre optics
- Includes a star topper with LEDs
- Sparkle baubles provided
- 1.8m black cable
- PLEASE NOTE - THIS TREE DOES NOT COME WITH A REMOTE CONTROL
- Timer included: 8hrs on/16hrs off

## Information
The images on show are of our real trees. Even with meticulous wrapping, each tree needs to be assembled correctly to get the desired look. First, assemble the tree foundation and then (if needed) install the lower section. Extend the branches of the upper portion down until you discover the electrical connection point. After the connection is completed, make sure the upper and lower electrical connections are in place before putting the top section of the tree into the lower pole (because 2ft, 3ft, and 4ft trees are all one-piece, this step is not required). Fold the first layer of branches just above horizontal form, working your way up from the base of the tree; this should give the branches a narrow \"V\" shape. Once you reach the top layer of your tree, repeat these steps for the remaining tiers. Before you plug in your tree, attach any ornaments or other decorations it may have! If gaps are evident from different angles, raising the back branches relative to the front branches may help. This fills in the \"visual gaps\" without sacrificing the appearance of layers. Work your way down the tree, starting at the top, to disassemble it. Available here as a 7ft (210cm) tree.

## Information
Our Richmond Fir is a traditional Christmas tree for any living room, grand hallway or shop display. The tree features a 3 part system offering much easier assembly, simply connect the base to the three pieces, unfold the branches, reposition and plug it in. Key features 9 lighting modes with remote control — warm white, multicolour, or combined effects in steady, fade, flash, and alternating patterns Dual-colour LED lights, pre-lit with no extra wiring needed to connect sections Full, lifelike hinged branches for quick assembly and a traditional Christmas look Sturdy stand for lasting, stable everyday use What's included 1 x pre-lit Richmond Fir Christmas tree 1 x Stand 1 x Storage Bag 1 x Remote control Dimensions 6ft: approx. 180cm height, approx. 100cm at base, 798 branch tips 7ft: approx. 210cm height, approx. 125cm at base, 1,098 branch tips Good to know Sent by courier with free standard UK delivery Covered by a 1-year manufacturer warranty FAQs Does it need assembly? Simple assembly required — the tree sections connect together (with built-in power sockets linking the lights automatically) and attach to the stand with 3 hand-tightened bolts, no power tools needed. Once assembled, gently spread out the branches and tips to shape your tree. What lighting modes does it have? The tree features 9 modes via the included remote: steady, fading, and flashing effects in warm white, multicolour, or both combined — plus an alternating mode. How are the lights powered? The tree itself is mains-powered — simply plug in to enjoy. The remote control runs on a button cell battery (not included). Is it suitable for outdoor use? Designed for indoor use. For best results and safety, display in a dry, sheltered location. Safety Information For indoor use only. Do not use if damaged or wet. Unplug by grasping the plug, not the cord. Keep cords, batteries, and small parts away from children and pets — the remote's button cell battery (not included) can cause serious harm if swallowed.

## Information
Create a warm festive display with this 7ft pre-lit artificial Christmas tree, designed in a traditional green fir style for easy seasonal decorating. The tree features decorative red berries and pine cones, along with warm white LED lights to give your home a welcoming Christmas glow. With eight lighting modes, you can choose the effect that suits your space, from steady illumination to twinkle, waves, slow fade and combination settings. The result is a versatile centrepiece that helps you enjoy a classic Christmas look without the need for separate string lights. Made from eco-friendly PVC material, this artificial tree offers durability and practical reuse year after year. Its reusable construction makes it a convenient choice for households looking for a dependable seasonal decoration that can be brought out each Christmas. The sturdy metal folding base helps keep the tree upright once assembled, supporting stable placement in living rooms, hallways or other indoor festive displays. Easy installation and dismantling also make it straightforward to set up and store away when the season ends. This decorated full green pine-style tree combines a traditional look with practical features, making it suitable for customers who want an attractive Christmas centrepiece that is simple to use and built for repeated seasonal decorating. The warm white LEDs add an inviting finish, while the berries and pine cones provide extra detail that helps the tree stand out. Whether used as the main tree in your home or as part of a coordinated festive scheme, it provides a ready-made decorative solution with familiar Christmas styling. For added convenience, the design is intended to be economical and safe thanks to its flame-retardant materials and reusable PVC build. That makes it an appealing option for families and anyone who wants a classic artificial Christmas tree with lighted decoration already included.

## Features
- Starburst Christmas Tree with static warm white micro LEDs
- Available in 1.5m and 1.8m sizes with 1200 / 1600 LEDs

- UK mains powered with 5m cable for flexible positioning

## Information
Create a spectacular festive centrepiece with this Christow Micro LED Starburst Christmas Tree. Finished in gold and illuminated by hundreds of static warm white micro LEDs, it has a stunning starburst look for an enchanting light display. Available in 1.5m and 1.8m sizes, it's perfect for adding a magical festive glow to your home, garden, porch, or driveway. Starry Warm White Micro LEDs Coloured gold and illuminated by hundreds of warm white micro LEDs, the tree has a magical starburst look to brighten any setting. Smaller than standard LEDs, the micro LEDs allow the full silhouette of the tree to shine through for a more magical display. Built-In Timer Function Enjoy hassle-free festive lighting every evening with a built-in timer function. Once activated at your desired time, the tree automatically lights up at the same time each day before conveniently switching off six hours later, helping to save energy and reduce effort. Mains Powered with 5m Cable Powered by an IP20-rated UK transformer plug, the tree is suitable for plugging into an indoor socket only. A generous 5m cable gives you plenty of flexibility to place it outside while conveniently plugging it in indoors, making it perfect for a front lawn display. Easy Assembly & Outdoor Stability Simply twist the bottom pole onto the base, then twist the top pole onto the bottom pole to assemble the tree. Flexible branches can be carefully arranged to create a full starburst silhouette, while ground stakes help keep the base secure when displayed outdoors. ## Information
Our Aurora Winter Glow Christmas tree brings a magical, snow-kissed look to any living room, grand hallway or shop display. Delicately flocked in soft white for a frosted, just-fallen-snow finish, it's pre-lit with vibrant multi-colour and warm white LEDs offering 16 lighting functions - including twinkle effects and quick colour-flip transitions - making it a stunning centrepiece for the whole festive season. What's included 1 x pre-lit flocked Christmas tree 1 x Stand 1 x Remote control Dimensions 6ft: approx. 180cm height, approx. 105cm at base, 1234 branch tips 7.5ft: approx. 228cm height, approx. 125cm at base, 1870 branch tips Good to know Sent by courier with free standard UK delivery Covered by a 1-year manufacturer warranty FAQs What sizes are available? This tree is available in two heights - 6ft and 7.5ft - so you can choose the best size for your space. Does it need assembly? Minimal assembly required. Simply unfold the branches and attach the tree to its stand. The sections connect via built-in power sockets, so lights link up automatically as you build the tree. A few bolts are hand-tightened during setup, no power tools required. Can I change the lighting effects? Yes, the tree features 16 modes via the included remote, covering steady, slow-fade, and twinkle effects in warm white, multicolour, and pastel, plus quick and slow colour-flip transitions and a demo mode that cycles through them all. How are the lights powered? The tree itself is mains-powered, simply plug in to enjoy. The remote control runs on a button cell battery (not included). Is it suitable for outdoor use? Designed for indoor use. For best results and safety, display in a dry, sheltered location. How is it delivered? Sent by courier with free standard UK delivery. Safety Information For indoor use only. Do not use if damaged or wet. Unplug by grasping the plug, not the cord. Keep cords, batteries, and small parts away from children and pets. The remote's button cell battery (not included) can cause serious internal injury if swallowed, sometimes within hours. If a battery is swallowed or you suspect ingestion, seek immediate medical attention. Ensure the battery compartment is securely closed at all times.

Our Richmond Fir is a traditional Christmas tree for any living room, grand hallway or shop display. The tree features a 3 part system offering much easier assembly, simply connect the base to the three pieces, unfold the branches, reposition and plug it in. Key features 9 lighting modes with remote control — warm white, multicolour, or combined effects in steady, fade, flash, and alternating patterns Dual-colour LED lights, pre-lit with no extra wiring needed to connect sections Full, lifelike hinged branches for quick assembly and a traditional Christmas look Sturdy stand for lasting, stable everyday use What's included 1 x pre-lit Richmond Fir Christmas tree 1 x Stand 1 x Storage Bag 1 x Remote control Dimensions 6ft: approx. 180cm height, approx. 100cm at base, 798 branch tips 7ft: approx. 210cm height, approx. 125cm at base, 1,098 branch tips Good to know Sent by courier with free standard UK delivery Covered by a 1-year manufacturer warranty FAQs Does it need assembly? ## Information
Our Aurora Winter Glow Christmas tree brings a magical, snow-kissed look to any living room, grand hallway or shop display. Delicately flocked in soft white for a frosted, just-fallen-snow finish, it's pre-lit with vibrant multi-colour and warm white LEDs offering 16 lighting functions - including twinkle effects and quick colour-flip transitions - making it a stunning centrepiece for the whole festive season. What's included 1 x pre-lit flocked Christmas tree 1 x Stand 1 x Remote control Dimensions 6ft: approx. 180cm height, approx. 105cm at base, 1234 branch tips 7.5ft: approx. 228cm height, approx. 125cm at base, 1870 branch tips Good to know Sent by courier with free standard UK delivery Covered by a 1-year manufacturer warranty FAQs What sizes are available? This tree is available in two heights - 6ft and 7.5ft - so you can choose the best size for your space. Does it need assembly? Minimal assembly required. Simply unfold the branches and attach the tree to its stand. The sections connect via built-in power sockets, so lights link up automatically as you build the tree. A few bolts are hand-tightened during setup, no power tools required. Can I change the lighting effects? Yes, the tree features 16 modes via the included remote, covering steady, slow-fade, and twinkle effects in warm white, multicolour, and pastel, plus quick and slow colour-flip transitions and a demo mode that cycles through them all. How are the lights powered? The tree itself is mains-powered, simply plug in to enjoy. The remote control runs on a button cell battery (not included). Is it suitable for outdoor use? Designed for indoor use. For best results and safety, display in a dry, sheltered location. How is it delivered? Sent by courier with free standard UK delivery. Safety Information For indoor use only. Do not use if damaged or wet. Unplug by grasping the plug, not the cord. Keep cords, batteries, and small parts away from children and pets. The remote's button cell battery (not included) can cause serious internal injury if swallowed, sometimes within hours. If a battery is swallowed or you suspect ingestion, seek immediate medical attention. Ensure the battery compartment is securely closed at all times.

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Pre-lit Artificial Christmas Tree
- Natural appearance
- LEDs: There are 8 modes
- 420 multicolor LEDs create an instant festive glow
- Eight light modes let you vary the display easily
- PVC material helps provide durability and storage
- 1800 tips give a fuller look once branches are shaped
- 10ft height suits larger rooms needing impact

## Information
Bring a warm festive feel to your home with this 7ft Green Alaskan Pine pre-lit artificial Christmas tree. Designed for medium to large sized rooms, it offers a classic seasonal look with a full, traditional profile and the convenience of built-in lighting. The wrapped construction gives the tree a neat appearance while helping create an attractive centrepiece for your Christmas display. This tree is supplied in a green finish and is made from PVC with metal elements, offering a practical artificial option for seasonal decorating. It includes 800 tips for a fuller look and 200 multicolour LEDs already fitted to save time during setup. With pre-installed lights, there is no need to add separate string lights, making decorating quicker and more straightforward. A choice of 8 light modes lets you tailor the atmosphere to suit different moments through the season. Options include waves, sequential, slogs, chasing/flash, slow fade, twinkle/flash, steady on and combination. Whether you want a gentle glow or a more lively effect, the lighting can be adjusted to suit your room and occasion. The tree measures 7ft / 2.1m / 210cm including the stand, with an approximate width of 125cm. Its proportions are suitable for homes where space matters but a substantial festive display is still desired. The design aims to make Christmas preparation easier by combining realistic styling with simple assembly and ready-made lighting. Energy efficient LEDs are another useful feature, with bulbs designed to last up to 50,000 hours under normal use. That makes this tree a practical choice for repeated seasonal decorating year after year. The wrapped construction also helps support an organised finish that works well in living rooms, hallways or larger open spaces. If you want an artificial Christmas tree that combines a traditional green look with convenient pre-lit lighting, this Alaskan Pine style offers an easy way to create an inviting festive focal point. It brings together size, coverage and lighting options in one decorative package for straightforward seasonal decorating. The multicolor LED effect adds brightness without needing extra decorations if you prefer a simple setup. For those who like to build on the base look, it also provides a strong starting point for baubles, ribbons and other festive ornaments. With its full appearance, wrapped construction and multiple light settings, this artificial Christmas tree is designed to offer dependable seasonal style. It suits shoppers looking for an attractive pre-lit option that helps reduce installation time while still creating an eye-catching Christmas display.
Bring a touch of holiday spirit with this pre-lit Pre-Lit Artificial Warm Multicolour LEDs tree, perfect for creating a warm and festive atmosphere in your home.

Bring luxurious elegance to your home this winter with the Christow Pre-Lit Flocked Verbier Fir Christmas Tree to create your dream centrepiece. The Hardwick 6ft Artificial Pre-Lit Christmas Tree by The Christmas Centre is a gorgeous centrepiece that will enhance your house over the course of the holiday season. ## Information
Transform your holiday décor with the beautifully crafted Kensington Artificial 4.5ft Potted Pre-Lit Frosted Fir Christmas Tree. Designed to resemble a snow-covered fir straight from the forest. The Kensington stands out because of its incredibly lifelike appearance, crafted using a high-quality blend of PE and PVC materials for unmatched realism and durability. It features hundreds of branch tips that create a full, lush silhouette, perfectly mimicking the look of a freshly chopped fir tree. The serene atmosphere of a wintry paradise is evoked by the rich green tone and frosted tips all throughout. products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Built-in warm white LEDs save time at setup
- Eight light modes let you vary the festive mood
- Hinged branches make assembly quicker and easier
- PVC foliage gives a classic green pine appearance
- Metal stand helps support the tree once assembled
- Choose from 9 light modes, including waves, sequential, slo-glo, chasing or flash, slow fade, twinkle or flash, steady on and combination.
- Warm white LED lights create a traditional festive glow for indoor Christmas decorating.
- Hinged branches make assembly quicker and easier, helping the tree take shape with minimal setup.
- Mains-powered design with a 2m cable for convenient connection to a household socket.
- Fire retardant construction supports safer seasonal use.

## Information
Create a warm festive setting with this 12ft pre-lit green Alaskan pine artificial Christmas tree. Designed for homes that want a fuller seasonal centerpiece, it offers a natural look with plenty of space for ornaments and decorations. The PVC construction helps give the tree its classic artificial pine finish, while the hinged design supports straightforward assembly and shaping once the sections are in place. Built-in warm white LEDs are fitted to save time and reduce the need for separate light strings. The lighting includes multiple modes, giving you flexibility to adjust the display to suit your room and festive mood. Options include waves, sequential, slogs, chasing/flash, slow fade, twinkle/flash, steady on and combination, so you can vary the atmosphere through the season. The tree is supplied with a metal stand to help support it once assembled. As with many artificial trees of this type, arranging the branches after installation will help achieve the best appearance and create a fuller look. The green finish provides a traditional Christmas style that works well as a centerpiece in medium to larger rooms where height makes an impact. This artificial Christmas tree is intended for repeated seasonal use and offers a practical alternative to a real tree when you want decorative impact without ongoing needle drop or watering. ## Information
Create a festive centrepiece with this 8ft pre-lit Californian pine artificial Christmas tree, designed to bring a snowy winter look to your home or seasonal display. The snow-covered tips give the tree a frosted finish, while the warm white LEDs add a welcoming glow without the need for separate string lights. With 1382 tips, it provides a full and decorative shape that looks attractive whether styled with ornaments or left simple and illuminated on its own. The hinged branch design helps make assembly quicker and less demanding, so you can spend less time setting up and more time enjoying the finished display. Once the season is over, the same hinged construction also makes disassembly and storage more straightforward. A metal stand is included to help support the tree during use, and the PVC tips are made for repeated seasonal decorating year after year. At approximately 100cm at the widest point, this tree offers a substantial profile suited to living rooms, hallways, reception spaces or retail displays where a strong festive feature is needed. The integrated warm white LEDs are energy saving and have a long life of up to 50,000 hours, helping provide reliable seasonal lighting across many Christmases. Whether you prefer a traditional decorated tree or a snowy illuminated look, this artificial Californian pine offers a practical and eye-catching option for Christmas decorating. The combination of snow-covered leaves, realistic styling and integrated lighting creates an inviting festive atmosphere that works well in both home and shop settings. Use it as a ready-lit base for baubles, ribbons and garlands, or enjoy its wintry appearance as it comes. Built with convenience in mind, it brings together easy setup, durable materials and decorative impact in one seasonal tree. This artificial Christmas tree is intended for indoor festive use as part of your seasonal décor. Its full shape, snowy finish and pre-lit design make it easy to create an impressive display without buying additional lights separately. For customers looking for a classic green Christmas tree with a frosted effect and integrated illumination, this option delivers a balanced mix of style, practicality and repeated-use value.

## Information
Embrace winter's charm with this miniature forest scene that combines four delicate spindle trees nestled in an authentic wood log base. Each tree showcases meticulous detailing with a dusting of snow that catches and reflects light, creating an enchanting display reminiscent of a serene winter woodland. The organic arrangement of the quartet provides depth and dimension, while the varying heights of the trees create visual interest from every angle. The natural wood log base adds rustic authenticity and grounds the composition perfectly. This seasonal accent piece works brilliantly as part of a larger winter display, particularly when paired with our ceramic pine cone trinket dishes, white ceramic fir trees, and complementary snowy tree sculptures in varying sizes. For maximum impact, consider grouping with our other wood-based tree arrangements, including the snowy fir duo and single specimen pieces. The carefully balanced proportions make this piece ideal for both expansive window displays and intimate tabletop settings, offering retailers multiple merchandising options throughout the winter season. The combination of traditional winter motifs with contemporary styling ensures broad customer appeal, while the quality materials and attention to detail justify its position as a higher-end seasonal offering that customers will treasure for years to come. This versatile piece transitions seamlessly from holiday-specific displays to general winter dcor, extending its selling season well beyond Christmas.

## Information
Bring the magic of a winter woodland into your home with the Christow Nordmann Fir Artificial Christmas Tree. Layered, uneven branches, tapered with gaps between them, capture the sparse, natural look of a real winter woodland fir. Lifelike PE and classic PVC tips add depth, fullness, and natural charm. The tree comes in three sections with hinged branches, twist-and-lock poles, and a sturdy metal stand for easy setup and styling. Instructions are included to guide you every step of the way. Start by securing the base section into the stand and pulling down the branches. Then repeat with the middle and top, locking each section into place and shaping the branches as you go. Crafted with a blend of moulded PE and traditional PVC tips, the tree has a natural woodland look with lifelike texture and detail. While the PE tips add depth and definition, the PVC tips help fill out the branches to replicate a real fir tree.

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Magical winter centrepiece
- Luxury snow flocked tips
- Hinged branch construction
- Green metal stand included
- Easy to assemble

## Information
Bring the magic of a winter woodland into your home with the Christow Nordmann Fir Artificial Christmas Tree. Layered, uneven branches, tapered with gaps between them, capture the sparse, natural look of a real winter woodland fir. Lifelike PE and classic PVC tips add depth, fullness, and natural charm. The tree comes in three sections with hinged branches, twist-and-lock poles, and a sturdy metal stand for easy setup and styling. Instructions are included to guide you every step of the way. Start by securing the base section into the stand and pulling down the branches. Then repeat with the middle and top, locking each section into place and shaping the branches as you go. Crafted with a blend of moulded PE and traditional PVC tips, the tree has a natural woodland look with lifelike texture and detail. While the PE tips add depth and definition, the PVC tips help fill out the branches to replicate a real fir tree.
